title: Norris' Sesame Pasta Salad
description: Pasta is tossed in a sesame dressing with cilantro, peanuts, and green onions for an Asian-inspired pasta salad perfect for any occasion.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes, or to taste
0.75 cup chopped fresh cilantro, or more to taste
0.75 cup shaved green onions, or more to taste
0.33333334326744 cup honey-roasted peanuts, or more to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes; drain.

Mix spaghetti, sesame oil, honey, soy sauce, corn oil, red pepper flakes, and salt together in a large bowl until spaghetti is evenly coated. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Add cilantro, green onions, peanuts, and sesame seeds; toss to combine.
